== '''Blood on the Streets of Kredon''' ==
Two police officers stand near a taped-off alley, their flashlights cutting through the dark. One complains about the city, the early sunsets, and how much he wants a promotion to get off the streets. The other reminds him to stay alert—there could still be someone around. They argue about whether the suspect is long gone, the usual crime in Chinatown, and how the city has gone downhill.
[[File:Orion's blood.png|thumb|The pool of blood left by Orion after being shot.]]
When they notice a large pool of blood, one officer points out there’s too much of it for the victim to have walked away. The other jokes that maybe someone just dumped a bucket of blood, which sparks another argument about taking death seriously. Their talk turns to society, violence, and how ''Eternum'' is corrupting people. The skeptical officer, Mark, blames the game for rising crime, while the other dismisses his rant. Frustrated, she says she’ll wait in the car for backup and tells him to keep his radio open. He agrees, and the scene falls quiet.

== '''Between Worlds''' ==
[[File:Calypso heals Orion after he teleports..png|thumb|Calypso heals Orion after he teleports.]]
Orion wakes in [[Calypso]]’s arms as she heals him, explaining that his wounds were severe—she even had to regenerate his blood. When she tries to stand, she nearly collapses from exhaustion, and Orion catches her. Before he can finish explaining how he got hurt, he suddenly vanishes.

He reappears in a rainy [[Kredon]] alley, confused to find himself unharmed. Police officers nearby notice him, shocked to see someone standing in the middle of a fresh crime scene. They shout commands and draw their weapons, mistaking him for a suspect. Panicking, Orion realizes he can’t explain the truth and runs. He turns a corner and unintentionally teleports again.
[[File:Calypso about to merk Orion.png|thumb|Calypso threatens Orion.]]
He reappears before Calypso, who instinctively raises her magic in defense, suspecting he might be an immortal. Orion quickly convinces her otherwise and she realizes her mistake. Embarrassed, she apologizes and says she must rest, opening a portal and disappearing into it, leaving Orion alone to make sense of what just happened.

== '''The Power Within''' ==
After Calypso departs to rest, Orion sinks down on the same rock where he first awoke, taking a deep breath to steady himself. His mind races, but he tries to focus, remembering how his emotions once pulled him back to Kredon. Closing his eyes, he concentrates on the sights and sounds around him—the earth beneath his hands, the chirping birds, the rushing water—and then the rain and scent of cookies from home. When he opens his eyes, he’s standing in Kredon again. Amazed, he realizes he’s learned to move between worlds without the neural implant.
[[File:Nova jumps Orion.png|thumb|Nova sneaks on Orion.]]
Nearby, police officers investigate the alley where he reappeared earlier, baffled by his sudden disappearance. Listening quietly, Orion decides to slip away before they notice him again. He heads back to [[Nova Johnson|Nova]]’s house, relieved to make it back unnoticed. As he debates whether to tell her about his new ability, Nova sneaks up and jumps on his back, shouting, “Missed you!”

== '''Unexpected Arrival in Tortuga''' ==
Startled by Nova sneaking up behind him, Orion accidentally teleports them both into Eternum—straight to Tortuga in The [[New World]]. The sudden shift leaves Nova visibly shaken, and [[Nancy Carter|Nancy]], who spots them appear, rushes over with concern. When Nova can’t bring herself to explain what happened, Nancy decides a bit of calm is what they need most and suggests they all do some yoga.

After the session, the tension lifts, and both Nova and Nancy tell Orion they understand what he’s going through. Just as things settle, a nearby pirate whistles at Nova, making her realize she’s still in her underwear from the teleportation. Flustered, she covers herself as Nancy laughs and hands over the new outfits she’d picked up from [[Wenlin]]. Once they’ve changed, the three agree to split up and start recruiting new crew members.

== '''Recruiting the New Crew Member''' ==
Orion makes his way to the bustling tavern in Tortuga, the air thick with the smell of rum and sea salt. He has one goal—to find a new crew member for their voyage to the Island of the Lost Souls. Three pirates are waiting to be interviewed, but he can only choose one.

=== Reddss ===
[[File:Blackheart Reddss.png|thumb|Blackheart Reddss]]
First up is [[Blackheart Reddss]], a wiry man with sharp eyes and even sharper superstition. He insists Orion spell his name with two “s’s” for good luck before asking about the job. Reddss warns there can be no bananas or cats aboard, then proudly announces he’s the best cook on the server. He then shows off a few “magic” tricks. Before leaving, Reddss offers Orion a sea urchin cake, promising to bake more once they’re out at sea.

=== Lordy ===
[[File:Lordy Silverhook.png|thumb|Lordy Silverhook]]
Next is [[Lordy Silverhook]], a swaggering pirate with a parrot named Lago perched on his shoulder. He claims he and Lago are the finest navigators in all of Tortuga, able to find anything on the ocean. Lordy lists his many talents—animal handling, hunting, rum tasting—and makes sure to repeat his navigation skills several times for good measure. He assures Orion that he won’t regret hiring him and that he’s ready to sail at dawn.

=== Scarlet ===
[[File:Scarlett.png|thumb|Scarlett]]
Finally, [[Red Scarlett|Red Scarlet]] struts in with confidence. She confirms she’s interested in the position and the treasure that comes with it. When Orion asks about her skills, she gives a teasing grin and boasts that she knows her way around a ship—wind, waves, cannons, and all. She says she’ll be touching up her makeup while waiting for Orion’s decision, clearly expecting to be chosen.

With all three pirates eager to join, Orion now has to decide which one will earn their place on the crew.

== '''The Decision and Outcome''' == 

=== '''If Orion Chooses Reddss''' ===
When Orion brings Blackheart Reddss aboard, he panics at the sight of two women, declaring it a curse. Nancy calmly explains that speaking to a woman breaks the bad luck, and Reddss sheepishly admits she’s right. He apologizes, introduces himself as a magician and cook, and offers Nova pastries to smooth things over.

Later, when the crew learns about a giant orca named Phil, Reddss insists he can handle it with his “sleepy cake” recipe. Ignoring everyone’s doubts, he lowers the cake by rope, warning that tossing it would bring bad luck. The sea suddenly explodes as Phil leaps up and swallows Reddss whole.

=== '''If Orion Chooses Lordy''' ===
When Orion brings Lordy Silverhook aboard, the flamboyant pirate proudly introduces himself and his parrot, Lago, as Tortuga’s best navigators. Though Lordy’s geography skills are questionable, Lago answers perfectly, earning Nancy’s respect and the role of navigator.

Later, when the crew encounters the giant orca Phil, Lordy claims he can speak to it. Boasting of past animal “negotiations,” he steps to the stern to prove his skill. With Lago circling above, Lordy calls out in his so-called orca dialect—just before Phil lunges from the water and swallows him whole.

=== '''If Orion Chooses Scarlet''' ===
If Orion chooses Scarlet for the crew, both Nancy and Nova disapprove of his choice. Her presence proves disastrous, as she ultimately becomes a sacrifice for Phil, the giant orca, who swallows her whole.

== '''Other Crew Additions''' ==
Nova introduced a new crew member, [[Mr. Tartaria]], who refused to reveal his real name, claiming he was hiding from secret agents of the New World Order. Orion tried to joke with him, but Tartaria launched into wild theories about global elites, satanic cabals, and even surveillance pigeons. Soon after, Nancy came down the stairs, announcing that everything was ready. Orion greeted her and noticed another new face: [[Zap]], a seasoned fisherman with twenty-five years’ experience and captain of his own ship for fifteen. He had sailed across the world and through ten servers of Eternum. Nancy assured Orion that Zap would be a valuable addition, and Zap shared that it had always been his dream to visit the Island of the Lost Souls.

== '''Encounter with Phil''' ==
[[File:Phil gobbles a crew member.png|thumb|Phil eats the crew member Orion chose.]]
As they sailed through icy waters, Tartaria rambled about JFK being killed by reptilian aliens for exposing humanity’s simulation and claimed Eternum was powered by the souls of the dead. Nova challenged him, but he dismissed her arguments and even insisted New York City didn’t exist. Zap then warned the crew about the Frostbone Icebergs and the legendary killer whale, Phil. Nova and Nancy laughed at the name until the ship shook violently. A massive shadow appeared below, and Zap ordered everyone to stay calm, explaining that survival would require a sacrifice—though he made it clear he wouldn’t volunteer. The crew member Orion had brought along—Reddss, Lordy, or Scarlet—attempted to calm Phil, but when it failed, the whale devoured them. Zap shouted for everyone to get out immediately.

== '''Siren’s Cove Chaos''' ==
[[File:Orion gets tied to the ship.png|thumb|Orion gets tied to the ship]]
Shaken but determined, the crew sails into Siren’s Cove. While seated, Orion notices Tartaria leap overboard and moves to investigate, only to hear an eerie melody luring him toward the ship’s edge. Entranced, he nearly gives in, but Nova catches him just in time. She and Nancy tie him to the mast for safety before checking on Zap.

A [[Mermaid]] jumps on the ship, speaking charmingly yet clearly trying to lure Orion into the sea. The siren magically frees Orion’s restraints, reaching for him, but Nancy hurls a spear, striking the siren through the neck. Orion tries to leap again, but Nova knocks him out with a tranquilizer dart. Nancy steers the ship toward Serenity’s Current, putting distance between them and the sirens.

== '''Trapped in the Paradox Archipelago''' ==
A few hours after the Siren’s Cove incident, Orion wakes up groggy on a beach, tranquilized but safe. Nancy reassures him that they’ve long since left the sirens’ territory and fills him in on everything that happened while he was unconscious. She explains that they’re now on the border between the Bay of the Undead and the Paradox Archipelago, and once they cross the archipelago, the Island of Lost Souls will come into view.
[[File:Zap gets demolished.png|thumb|Zap falls victim to the trap.]]
Zap, having gone to an old pirate outpost to get a better view because compasses don’t work in the area, explains the Archipelago’s tricky winds often make sailors circle endlessly. The only way forward is to trek across the main island on foot. Despite skepticism from Nova and Nancy and concerns from Orion about the plan’s safety, Zap shares stories from his years of experience to encourage them. As the crew follows him down the ramp, he inadvertently triggers a hidden trap and is struck by an arrow, abruptly ending both his pep talk and his life.

== '''Ed and Morty’s Price''' ==
After Zap is struck by the arrow, skeletons [[Ed and Morty]] panic—Morty exclaims, “Oh, please, not again!” while Ed scolds them for missing a warning sign. Orion and the crew regroup, cautious and alert, as Ed urges everyone back to the dock to prevent further accidents. Once settled, Ed demands to know what they’re doing there. Orion introduces himself by his nickname and explains their mission to reach the Island of Lost Souls.

Ed and Morty agree they can take the group to the island—but only the living can set foot on it, and they insist on payment. Orion negotiates, offering to buy one of Morty’s paintings and display it in the Tortuga tavern instead of paying with gold. Morty delightedly accepts the offer. With the deal struck, Ed warns them about Paradox beasts like gnomes and pheromone monkeys and promises to meet them at the cove in twenty minutes with kraken repellent. The group is left to enjoy the beach briefly before preparing to continue their journey.

== '''The Paradox Gnome’s Illusion''' ==
Down by the shore, Nova, Nancy, and Orion stretch out under the warm sun, deciding to rest before continuing their journey. But as they drift off, a Paradox Gnome creeps near and traps them in a hallucination—each lost in a false future.
[[File:Office illusion.png|thumb|The office Orion hallucinates.]]
Orion awakens at an office desk, staring blankly at a computer screen and a framed photo from [[Dalia Carter|Dalia]] and [[Jerry]]’s wedding. Confused but oddly calm, he rides the right elevator down to the reception area, where [[Charlotte]] greets him and says he’s needed in Meeting Room 2. Before heading there, he checks a voicemail from [[Penelope Carter|Penny]], who mentions she’ll be appearing on NBC later that evening.
[[File:Luna offers E to Orion.png|thumb|Luna offers ecstasy to Orion.]]
Inside the meeting room, Orion finds [[Luna Hernandez|Luna]] looking worn out and irritable. She tells Orion he is “tripping hard” and asks to share whatever he’s on. Things get stranger when he learns that [[Alex Bardot|Alex]] is their boss. After Alex leaves, Luna pulls out a bag of ecstasy, takes some, and offers it to Orion. Whether he accepts or not, the scene resets—he’s suddenly back at his desk, the day looping on itself.

Determined to make sense of things, Orion turns on the lounge TV to watch Penny’s NBC appearance. [[Anton Eggrik|The Host]] introduces her as a famous actress and influencer, even mentioning a scandalous movie scene. But when Orion hears it, he snaps—Penny would never do that. He shuts off the TV, realizing something’s wrong.

Moments later, [[Chang Wong|Chang]] passes by, chatting briefly before leaving to pick up his kids. Then Dalia calls. Orion heads to the coffee area to meet her, and when she appears, she’s clearly drunk. She vents angrily about Penny’s interview and tells Orion not to bring her up again. The tension grows until Orion senses this world isn’t real—he needs to get back to Kredon. Dalia says she can help if he follows her, but when he does, Dalia pushes him onto a couch and climbs on top of him, saying that she wants him to fuck her because Jerry can’t give her what she needs.

Orion then blacks out and wakes up after Dalia had left.

He wakes up again at his desk, dazed. This time, there’s a new email instructing him to go to the seventh floor. The left elevator won’t open, so he bolts up the stairs instead. There, he finds [[Annie Winters|Annie]] waiting. Calmly, she tells him he’s trapped inside his own mind—and the only way out is to shoot himself. Realizing it’s the only escape, Orion does so, and the illusion collapses. He jolts awake back in The New World, the false future fading from his mind like a bad dream.

== '''The Paradox Gnome’s Capture''' ==
[[File:The Paradox Gnome mindfucks Nancy.png|thumb|The Paradox Gnome mindfucks Nancy.]]
Orion snapped out of the [[Paradox Gnome]]’s illusion to see it sprinkling magical dust over Nancy and Nova. Acting fast, he subdued it and tied it up, then woke his companions. Each of them took turns punching the gnome as it confessed that it had only enabled a narrator their minds created. The gnome admitted its goal had been to trap them in nightmares, steal their ship, and leave them lost in the looping Paradox Canyons. It explained that only the living were affected by its mindfucks, which is why Davy Jones’ skeletons were immune. Though it claimed it could guide them out, the gnome revealed it was stalling to make its escape and vanished into thin air before offering any real help.

Panicking after the Gnome's escape, Nancy calmly comes up with a plan to transform [[Dione]] into a flare gun in order for [[Ed and Morty]] to find them. They also try navigating the canyon, but give up after they end up where they started. To pass the time, they all share a bottle of rum and ask each other various questions. Eventually Nancy comes to the conclusion that Orion and Nova had a romantic session earlier. After Nancy slowly gets Nova to open up about her true feelings, all three of them share a romantic scene. Afterwards, Ed and Morty find them in the canyon and rescue them to rush to the island.

== Obtaining the Gem of Doom ==
[[File:Gem and Heart Exchange.png|thumb|Orion and El Coyote trade their items.]]
The ship arrives as close as possible to the Island of the Lost Souls, but they do not have enough time to navigate around the shallow waters before the island sinks. Orion uses his powers to sprint to the island and obtains the Heart of the Abyss. Somehow, [[El Coyote]] has also reached the island. Upon being questioned, El Coyote reveals that he wants the Heart of the Abyss in order to speak to the dead, specifically his daughter. They finalize their agreement to exchange the Heart of the Abyss for the Gem of Doom, and both escape before the island sinks. 
Before they can leave Eternum, [[The Founder]] makes a public announcement about the recent Xenomorph crisis, announcing a competition to kill as many Xenomorphs as possible with the reward being the [[Gem of Doom|9th Gem of Doom]]. After Nancy leaves, Orion and Nova cannot use the exit portal to return, before realizing they teleported into Eternum rather than using a neural implant. 

== The Real World ==
Nova panics after realizing that they could've died multiple times in Eternum, but is comforted after a kiss. After realizing Nova's parents are already home, Orion is pushed outside with the sun already rising.
[[File:Mr. Hernandez scares Annie.png|thumb|Mr. Hernandez scares Annie]]
A few days later, [[Annie Winters|Annie]] shows her dress to [[Luna Hernandez|Luna]] for her date with Orion. Annie apologizes for high fiving Luna at the café, before talking about her plans for the date. Luna figures out that Annie is going on a date with Orion, as shown by her vision earlier. Before leaving, [[Mr. Hernandez]] scares Annie, causing her to faint.

== '''Chang and Orion''' ==
Orion adjusted his sweater while Chang stared in awe, calling him beautiful and saying he looked like a gigachad. Orion laughed it off, insisting it was just jeans and a sweater from Nordstrom. They joked about his tired eyes from too much time in Eternum, and Orion promised to take a break once they collected all ten Gems.

Chang bragged about his fourth date with [[Micaela Garcia|Micaela]] and hinted things might get serious. Orion teased him, and they planned to catch up at the gym the next morning before Orion’s next mission.

Before leaving, Orion offered to bring Chang into Eternum without needing an implant, but Chang refused, saying he’d rather stay grounded in reality. Orion laughed, teleported away, and left Chang staring at the empty spot. “Holy crap… he even took the bottle,” Chang muttered to himself.

== '''The Hunt on Andromeda''' ==
[[File:Annie recaps events.png|thumb|Annie does a recap on everything.]]
When Orion arrived in [[Andromeda]], Annie and Luna called him over, showing off their new outfits with unique abilities. After a bit of teasing, Annie tested Orion on recent events, but when he got the answer wrong, she filled him in on the current Gem holders and everything that had happened so far.
[[File:Annie's Solar Cataclysm.png|thumb|Annie unleashes the ''Solar Cataclysm'']]
Before they could continue, the ground began to shake—xenomorphs were closing in. Annie quickly trapped Orion and Luna inside glowing force fields for protection. With a smirk, she gave a dramatic, villain-style speech and unleashed the ''Solar Cataclysm'', a blinding explosion that wiped out everything in sight.

When the smoke cleared, Annie released them from the barriers, admitting it would be a while before she could use that much power again. She and Luna said their goodbyes, heading off together as Orion prepared to teleport away.

== '''At the Restaurant''' ==
Orion waited at the restaurant, checking his phone when he got a text from Annie saying she’d be late because her bus was stuck in a flooded underpass. While waiting, Orion noticed [[Noah and Raul]] talking with a man he didn’t recognize—[[Giuseppe Bellini]]. The air around them was tense. Giuseppe praised Raul’s wine, then dropped his real reason for being there: a final warning.

He reminded Raul that for over twenty years, the seven great families kept a balance—Mendoza ruled South America, [[Hugo]] had Mexico, Ivanov had Russia, Hiromi had Asia, Callahan the East Coast, Raul the West, and Giuseppe controlled Europe and Eternum.
[[File:Dangerous dinner.png|thumb|Noah, Raul, and Giuseppe have a tense meeting.]]
Giuseppe demanded Raul stay out of Eternum. Raul refused, saying it was big enough for both of them. Giuseppe warned that with Mendoza, Callahan, and Hugo backing him, Raul didn’t stand a chance.

Noah tried to cool things down, and Giuseppe smirked, telling Raul he should’ve listened to his brother long ago. Raul gave a tense smile back. Watching from a distance, Orion could tell—this wasn’t just dinner. It was a warning shot.

=== '''Waiting and Dinner''' ===
[[File:Annie and Orion's pinky promise.png|thumb|Annie and Orion pinky promise ten years ago.]]
Trying not to stare much longer, Orion looked down at his phone again—messages from Nova, Chang, and Alex lighting up the screen. The quiet moment brought back memories of when he first met Annie and Chang ten years ago. They were just kids then—Annie heading to the zoo with her dad, who got called into work, and Chang convincing everyone to pretend to be Star Wars characters for lunch the next day. Before leaving, Annie made Orion promise not to ignore her at school, sealing it with a pinky-promise.

When Annie finally arrived, a bit out of breath, Orion smiled and told her it was fine—what mattered was that she showed up and looked amazing. They laughed over old memories, testing each other on details from their past—what Annie wore the day they met, what she wished for on their first birthday together. Her answer was simple: to be together forever.

Their waitress, [[Eulalie]], quickly appeared, full of charm and confidence. She had already been flirting earlier when Orion first sat down, teasing him about the lowered drinking age and slipping in suggestions about “late-night spots.” Trying to be polite, he brushed it off, hoping Annie wouldn’t notice.

Eulalie brought out their first dishes—shrimp, beef, and tuna steak—and as she set them down, she gave Orion a sly look and reminded him that her “offer” still stood. Annie caught the exchange but stayed calm, telling Orion she trusted him completely. She wanted the night to be about them.

=== '''After Dinner''' ===
[[File:Annie is pissed tf off at Eulalie.png|thumb|Annie threatens Eulalie.]]
After dinner, Eulalie returned, saying the restaurant was closing. As she walked away, she casually said, “Oh, and it’s 307.” Orion thought it was the bill at first until Annie realized it was a hotel room number. He groaned in disbelief, but Annie stayed cool. A few minutes later, Annie excused herself and found Eulalie near the kitchen. Her voice was calm but sharp as she asked if she was invisible. Eulalie tried to laugh it off, saying she was only joking, but Annie made it clear she didn’t appreciate the flirting. She warned Eulalie not to look at Orion like that again—or it’d be the last time she did. Eulalie quickly backed down, terrified.

=== '''Tense Departures''' ===
As dinner wrapped up, Giuseppe Bellini stood, praising the meal before saying he had to leave. Raul agreed, letting the restaurant’s quiet settle back in. Giuseppe apologized for their failed negotiations, wishing they could’ve reached common ground. Raul tried to keep things cordial, reminding him they’d at least reminisced about the old days—and that Giuseppe finally met his brother. But Giuseppe smiled and said he already knew Noah, recalling a brief encounter in New York while visiting Callahan. Raul looked surprised, but Noah brushed it off, saying it wasn’t important. Giuseppe complimented Noah’s sharp mind, then excused himself for his flight, leaving without looking back. Watching him go, Raul sighed, admitting to Noah that Giuseppe was right—they might not win this war. Still, he said, avoiding it wasn’t an option. Whatever came next, he was sure of one thing: he could always count on his brother.

== '''A Romantic Moment''' ==
Annie returned to Orion, smiling as if nothing had happened. She told him to follow her to the hotel she had booked nearby, wanting to end the night on their own terms. Whatever tension lingered from dinner was gone—the only thing that mattered now was them and they share a romantic moment. At the end of their scene, Annie and Orion tell each other that they love one another.

== The Gym with Dalia ==
[[File:Dalia gets that protein powder.png|thumb|Dalia is surprised with protein powder for an early birthday gift.]]
At the gym, Orion finished a round on the punching bag while [[Millie]] chatted with Dalia nearby. Wiping sweat from his face, Orion said he was done, and Dalia told him, “Let’s go.” As they packed up, Orion suggested meeting at the entrance in forty minutes—enough time for Dalia to shower and for him to give Alex her notes. Before parting, Dalia updated him on the latest standings of ''The Big Hunt'' and joked about protein shakes, which made Orion mention he had a surprise for Dalia. The BBQ-flavored protein powder he’d bought for her birthday. Dalia reminded him her birthday wasn’t for another month, and he grinned, saying, “That’s why it’s a surprise.” Dalia tells Orion that she is going to use this powder in some new recipes. She then tells Orion to close his eye so he can try her new protein cinnamon rolls. Orion says that they taste amazing. With that, they say their goodbyes—Dalia heading to the locker room and Orion toward the pool to meet Alex. 

== '''Alex at the Pool''' ==
[[File:Alex and Orion kiss.png|thumb|Alex and Orion kiss.]]
At the pool, Orion met up with Alex, and after a bit of small talk, she leads him into the changing room so he could drop off her notes. Once inside, Alex suddenly pressed him against the wall and says that she has missed him. The moment grew intense, leading to a romantic encounter. During their scene, Orion and Alex teleport to different Eternum servers before ending back in the bathroom stall. Afterward, Alex jokes that she is pregnant from their time in her apartment. If Orion reacts with excitement, then Alex with admit it’s a joke and Orion tells her that he loves her. Just then, Alex’s coach walks in, calling her name. Thinking fast, Alex claimed she’d just taken too long because she’d had a bad case of diarrhea and will clean it up. Alex rushes back to Orion, still in the stall, and tells him she loves him too before heading back to her swim practice.

== '''Arrival at the Valley of the Kings''' ==
Orion took longer than expected with Alex, so Dalia texted him, reminding him she was still waiting. When he finally showed up by the entrance, she was in a forgiving mood—especially after he gave her the BBQ protein powder. They talked casually about the weather until they realized they’d missed the bus, and the next one wouldn’t get them home in time for their meeting in the [[Valley of the Kings]] server.

Thinking quickly, Orion suggested taking his express route, explaining he no longer needed the E-suit to access Eternum. Dalia hesitated but agreed, and the two ducked under a fire escape to avoid the rain. Orion wrapped an arm around her waist, took a slow breath, and as he exhaled, they suddenly appeared in the blazing desert of the Valley of the Kings.

Dalia looked around in awe, impressed they’d landed right beside an exit portal. The heat quickly set in, and she shrugged off her jacket as they walked through the sand toward a small oasis—their meeting spot. Just as Dalia pointed out where she’d stashed their outfits, they spot Jerry, irritated about their lateness. Luckily, he explained that [[Samir]] had sent word pushing the meeting back forty minutes. Relieved, Dalia told Orion to change and get ready before Samir arrived.

== '''Jerry’s Dramatic Breakdown''' ==
As Dalia went to change, Orion asked Jerry where the extra outfit was. Jerry started complaining that everyone was late and that no one cared about him. Orion reminded him they’d already apologized and that he wouldn’t have invited him if he didn’t. Jerry went on about how people once feared “Sir Jermaine of Noriander” and now just mocked him.
[[File:Jerry tries to be him.png|thumb|Jerry draws his sword on Orion.]]
He suddenly drew his sword, declaring he wouldn’t be disrespected anymore—then froze, staring at Orion. “Holy smokes! Since when are you so shredded?” he blurted, dropping his sword. Orion awkwardly thanked him while Jerry gushed over his physique and complained his own workouts weren’t paying off.

Orion suggested maybe he was overtraining. Jerry instantly calmed down, saying his therapist told him to express himself more and that the outburst was “just for show.” Then he bombarded Orion with gym questions until Orion finally said he needed to change into his Ishari outfit. Jerry eagerly led the way, still talking about workouts, while Orion sighed, thinking this new gym-bro version might be even worse than before.

== '''Waiting for Samir to Arrive''' ==
[[File:Dalia kisses Orion (Valley of the Kings).png|thumb|Dalia kisses Orion after doing 300 push-ups.]]
While waiting for Samir, Orion tackles 300 pushups. Dalia, impressed he actually finishes, kisses him on the cheek. Orion asks for another, and this time the kiss is deep and passionate. She teases him before slipping out of sight.

Orion notices Jerry sitting nearby and awkwardly apologizes for kissing Dalia, explaining he didn’t want it to be uncomfortable since he knows Jerry liked her. Jerry brushes it off, saying he’s over it and knows Dalia never looked at him that way. Orion expresses relief that they can finally talk like this.

Jerry admits he just wants to achieve something he can be proud of, blaming his bad luck in Eternum for multiple failures, many of which happened while Orion was present. He recounts recent deaths, including an incident yesterday in Polaxymer-83 where everything suddenly went black. Orion reassures him that things will improve, and Jerry reluctantly accepts, saying, “If you say so.”

== '''Samir’s Arrival and the Mission Briefing''' ==
[[File:Samir.png|thumb|Samir arrives]]
Samir finally shows up, prompting Dalia to snap at him for being late. He quickly apologizes and explains the delay before giving a detailed rundown about the Ishari and their motives. Orion introduces himself as Heracles, and Dalia identifies herself. Jerry asks if new members are welcome, and Samir confirms they are. He warns the group that time is short but promises to get them to [[Hassan Al-Rashid]]’s doorstep. 

Samir explains that his people built the Valley of the Kings long before Hassan arrived with money and a jackal army, enslaving players and NPCs. Dalia cuts the lore short, and Samir lays out the plan: they will split up, meet Yssandra by the horses, and use a slave delivery to enter the citadel. Orion voices concerns about the risks, but Samir assures him the route can work if they are careful. Once the briefing ends, Dalia nods, wishing everyone luck before heading off to join the slave delivery portion of the mission.

== '''Infiltrating the Citadel''' ==
[[File:Ishari safe house.png|thumb|Ishari safe house]]
Samir led them into the Citadel, explaining how Hassan had bought his way in and crushed any opposition with his jackals. Orion wondered how Hassan kept winning the Big Hunt, but Samir hinted the answer wasn’t obvious and refocused on the plan. Their entry point would be the crowded central market. They slipped into an Ishari safe house behind the market, a repurposed guard building scented with incense. 

Jerry hesitated, wanting to stay behind, but Orion convinced him to help by promising rank and a share of the victory. Samir outlined their approach: create a distraction at the south archway guarded by a single jackal, slip past to Hassan’s chambers to gather intel, then return to the base and lock the door. The password “Free Sands” was mandatory. Samir also mentioned that Dalia might already be inside with the slave delivery, close enough to Hassan to collect crucial information.  

== '''Dalia Faces Hassan Al-Rashid''' ==
[[File:Dalia stands before the Sultan.png|thumb|Dalia stands before the Sultan]]
Dalia successfully joined the slave delivery, ready to make a break if needed while waiting for The Sultan. When Hassan Al-Rashid arrived, he stated he only wanted pure virgins. After discovering two girls weren’t, he ordered a jackal guard to take them to the incubation room. Dalia, the only one left, adopted a defiant stance, prepared to fight. 

Hassan watched her with a mix of amusement and disdain as [[The Oracle]] confirmed her purity. Pleased, he commanded The Oracle to escort Dalia to his chambers with two guards. Dalia remained calm, aware of her role for Orion’s mission, and Hassan promised he would return to answer her questions before leaving the Citadel.

== '''Blending In at the Market''' ==
Orion moved through the bustling Citadel marketplace, keeping his head down and trying to blend in with the crowd. He reminded himself that all he had to do was stay unnoticed for ten minutes. Spotting an unattended corner, he approached a merchant to start small talk. The man, Alfonso, eagerly welcomed him and tried to sell him everything from swords to camels. Orion politely declined, explaining he already had a “personal merchant” who followed him everywhere. Amused, Alfonso backed off, joking that Orion should at least buy a gift for his “beautiful girl.” When Orion admitted his love life was complicated, Alfonso teased him until Orion accidentally poured out his feelings about all the girls in his life. Realizing how much he’d overshared, Orion cut the talk short, thanked Alfonso, and kept moving. 

A few stalls over, he tried to talk to another vendor—this one much less friendly. The merchant immediately insulted him, calling him Ishari trash and shouting for the guards. Orion panicked, insisting he wasn’t one of them, only wearing their armor as a disguise. The man stopped shouting and, to Orion’s surprise, apologized. He confessed he used to be one of the Ishari until their leader, Samir, betrayed him by sleeping with his girlfriend. His anger toward Samir still burned, but he admitted he’d rejoin the Ishari if they ever found a new leader. Orion wished him luck and left, quietly noting that he’d need to keep an eye on Samir.
[[File:The old Merchant.png|thumb|The old Merchant]]
Further along, Orion found an old man selling copper statues of the goddess Psyche. The merchant instantly saw through his disguise, calling him “Heracles” and warning that he was close to a point of no return. The cryptic speech reminded Orion of the Syndicate, a mysterious group that always seemed to know too much. When Orion tried questioning him, the old man brushed it off and offered a statue for three eternals. Out of curiosity, Orion bought one and left, uneasy about the man’s parting words: “It can still land on a different side.” 

=== '''Running Into Maat''' ===
[[File:Maat aims a crossbow at Orion.png|thumb|Maat]]
As Orion wandered deeper into the market, he noticed a merchant sleeping at her stall. When he tried waking her, the woman grumbled about her job and fell right back asleep. Orion was about to walk off when a familiar voice called his name. He turned to see [[Maat]], crossbow in hand, furious. The two traded insults about a chaotic past encounter, each blaming the other for what happened. After a heated argument, Maat demanded 80 eternals to “settle things.” Tired of the drama, Orion paid her just to end the conversation. Maat thanked him and promised to repay him with interest, declaring she’d even build a statue in his honor if she ever ruled the Valley of the Kings. 

As she disappeared into the crowd, Orion sighed and checked the time—it was already 15:30. He’d spent too long stalling and still hadn’t seen Samir. Looking around the crowded market, he muttered to himself, “Where the hell is Samir?”

== Commander Hasler or Doctor Mercer ==
Orion meets either [[Commander Hasler]] or [[Dr. Mercer]] in the market depending on the choice he made in Andromeda during [[Chapter 4]].

=== Doctor Mercer Route ===
[[File:Dr. Mercer in the valley of kings.png|thumb|Dr. Mercer]]
Doctor Mercer recognized Orion immediately and greeted him like an old prize. She admitted she had tracked Eternum’s top players and had been watching him, praising his speed and the rare [[Gem of Doom]] he possessed. Mercer said she had just left a meeting with Commander Hasler, claimed they had joined forces (she killed him), and invited Orion for a private walk through the palace gardens. Once alone she revealed the truth: she was behind the Xenomorph operation, mass producing creatures to raise the Sultan’s kill counts in exchange for resources, and she needed the perfect host. She bragged that many captured NPCs and people had been used for incubation and that discarded girls likely went to the palace basement incubation room hidden behind a false wall in the east wing. When Orion pressed for the Ishari girls, a jackal guard threatened him, Mercer gloated and urged him to come quietly to the lab. In one move Orion disarmed and killed the guard, and Mercer celebrated his power, calling him the perfect host. He then had a choice: kill her or spare her. If he spares her, she sneers that his mercy is a weakness in her ideal host. If he kills her, she dies (duh) 
=== Commander Hasler Route ===
[[File:Commander Hasler in valley of the kings.png|thumb|Commander Hasler]]
Orion runs into Commander Hasler, who reminds him they met back at the Astrocorp station and brags the bombing there did its job. Hasler says he’s hunting Xenomorphs too and wants Doctor Mercer stopped — he blames her for the infestation and for inflating the Sultan’s kill counts by mass producing the creatures. When Samir reports the original plan has failed and they can’t get everyone into the palace today, Hasler steps in with a deal: he’ll help Orion get into the palace, but only if Orion kills Doctor Mercer and anyone tied to her Xenomorph operation inside the palace. Reluctant but desperate to find Dalia, Orion accepts. Hasler explains the plan: make a real-looking fight at the south arch so the guards rush in, let two team members slip past the distracted guard, then use a trapdoor to reach the palace. Time is short and Orion must choose who distracts the guard now. Orion and whoever he chooses (Jerry or Samir) will run into Doctor Mercer and she will insist to speak to Orion alone. 

== Dalia in The Sultan's Chambers ==
[[File:Dalia in the chambers.png|thumb|Dalia in the chambers]]
Dalia, now in the chambers, has a discussion with The Oracle where Dalia learns that the sultan brings virgins here to deflower them. Dalia is disgusted by this revelation and demands to be let go. She then takes matters into her own hands and kills the two jackal guards and holds a knife to The Oracles throat. Dalia then demands answers from The Oracle. She tells Dalia everything before Dalia kills her. 

== Samir or Jerry Scene ==

=== If Samir was Picked by Orion ===
While searching for Dalia, Orion spots Samir hiding. Startled, Samir admits fear and refuses to check the dungeons due to the Sultan’s kill-on-sight orders. Orion urges him to act, but Samir quits, naming Orion the new leader of the Ishari. He confesses he never wanted the responsibility and leaves, wishing Orion luck and apologizing to the tribe.

=== If Jerry was Picked by Orion ===
Jerry screamed for help as Orion realized he was in trouble and rushed to figure out what was happening. Jerry crawled backward in panic while a Jackal guard advanced with its spear raised, begging for mercy and insisting he wasn’t a threat or a thief. Just as the guard struck, Jerry opened his eyes to find he was still alive, shouting in disbelief that the curse was broken. Orion had been moving through the massive palace, frustrated by its maze-like halls as he searched for the storage tower. He ordered Jerry to check the dungeons for Dalia and retreat through an exit portal if she wasn’t there, warning him not to die. Jerry agreed and ran off to complete the mission. 

== Finding Dalia ==
[[File:Orion and Dalia resting.png|thumb|Orion and Dalia]]
Dalia and Orion, frantically searching the palace for each other, finally reunite. Dalia embraces him tightly, ready to share what she discovered, but is interrupted by a palace-wide announcement. They quickly head to a secret Ishari headquarters to lay low. There, they exchange everything they've learned. As the conversation deepens, Dalia confesses how much she enjoys being with Orion, then suddenly asks if he likes her. Orion has the chance to say, "I love you," and if he does, they share a kiss before sharing a romantic moment. 

== Samir or Jerry Scene 2 ==

=== If Samir was Picked by Orion ===
A frantic knock signals Samir’s arrival. After recalling the password, Samir bursts in, nearly compromising their cover when he sees Orion covering himself. He warns them that guards are sweeping the Citadel, blocking exits, and that Hassan al-Rashid won’t stop until they’re found. Before leaving, Samir reminds Orion of his new leadership role, promises to alert the lieutenants, and admits he forgot to grab his opium bag.

=== If Jerry was Picked by Orion ===
Jerry called out for Orion, panicking as he tried to break down the door until Orion shouted that he was fine. Jerry rushed in with an Ishari girl, warning that the Sultan’s guards and golems were raiding the Citadel. He’d ordered the soldiers to retreat but stayed behind to make sure Orion was safe. Jerry explained he was now the new leader of the Ishari, which the girl confirmed, though even he admitted it might’ve been by chance. Orion told them to find shelter, and Jerry dramatically praised him as the future King of Eternum before pledging the Ishari’s loyalty to the WRE. As Jerry turned to leave, he saw Dalia wrapped in a blanket and quietly admitted how much it hurt to see her. Accepting defeat, he promised to return stronger, said goodbye, and left as Orion wished him luck.

== Returning to Kredon ==
[[File:Dalia gets dropped off back in Kredon.png|thumb|Dalia gets dropped off back in Kredon]]
Orion confirmed Jerry’s warning was true and said it was time to leave, planning to report back to Nancy and make a plan to stop Hassan’s Xenomorph farms. Dalia teased him about being called the future King of Eternum, and after some playful flirting, they teleported back to rainy Kredon. Orion said it felt good to be home despite past trouble, while Dalia joked about him always finding danger. He told her to stay safe and let him handle the risks from now on. She agreed, saying she needed a hot shower, but teased that he was leaving her to face awkward questions alone. After a few more jokes and goodbyes, they told each other they loved one another before Orion teleported away, leaving Dalia smiling to herself and thinking she’d need new clothes—and someone to tell about what happened.

== The Inn ==
Orion shivered, realizing it hadn’t been the best idea to show up in his current outfit, coming straight from the Valley of Kings. Luckily, the inn held heat well, either due to thick stone walls or some hidden magic. Inside, he found Calypso drinking and laughing with other players, celebrating with music and toasts. Orion greeted her, concerned she might be overexerting herself with the Elarisil ritual, but she assured him she was fine and had been spending time among the common folk to clear her mind. She introduced her companions, Gwen and John, and Orion was glad to see her well. 

As they talked, Orion noticed her reuse of an outfit from the Western server, praising her for it, though he worried about her and whether [[Hyril'ar]] really existed. He proposed inviting her on an adventure in the Andromeda server, and she eagerly agreed. Their conversation was interrupted by a cryptic voice, Idriel, warning him about the chaos of fate. Before Orion could process this, Thanatos attacked, striking him and overpowering him despite his best efforts. Calypso was then chained by the neck by Dimeritium.  As Thanatos demanded the Gems of Doom, Orion realized he couldn’t defeat him, suffering severe injuries. Just as Thanatos raised his sword to finish him, Calypso, restrained by the dimeritium chains, supposedly magicless, used her magic and pure strength to break free, saving them both.

== A Strange New Place ==
Disoriented and injured, Orion found himself in a pond within a forest next to Calypso, who was weak but alive. He resolved to get her to a healer and decided to teleport them to the Agora server. As he tried to focus, he realized his powers were blocked, and he couldn’t sense anything, not even Kredon. Suddenly, he spots [[Lorelei]] and asks her what server they are in, mistaking her for a player. Loreeli calls out to her father who hurries over. [[General Arannis|General Arannis Thornvale]], who demanded to know who Orion was and why he was touching the Princess with his filthy, unworthy hands. Orion tried to ask where he was and the elven soldier planted his spear in the mud, giving Orion answers to his questions thought he doesn't deserve them. General Arannis introduces himself and his daughter, Lonelei, and declaring Calypso the rightful heir of the throne, the last of true descendant of [[Anima the Radiant|Queen Anima]], heiress of the Sy-tel-quissir, last of her bloodline and sovereign of the most powerful realm on the continent, Hyril'ar.
